name: Non-genetic Cardiac Rhythm Disease

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Electrocardiographic Diagnostic Criteria for Acquired Cardiac Arrhythmias

criteria.description: Presence of abnormal cardiac rhythm on electrocardiogram (ECG) not explained by genetic causes
Lack of pathogenic mutations in known arrhythmia-associated genes
History of precipitating factors such as ischemic heart disease, electrolyte imbalance, or drug-induced arrhythmia
Symptoms consistent with arrhythmia such as palpitations, syncope, or dizziness

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of ECG abnormalities consistent with arrhythmia and exclusion of genetic causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires careful exclusion of inherited arrhythmia syndromes and identification of secondary causes.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Irregular cardiac rhythm detected on ECG

searchTerms: racing heart with documented rhythm issues
feeling faint related to heart rhythm

common.symptomName: Fatigue secondary to decreased cardiac output
searchTerms: low energy due to poor blood flow

common.symptomName: Shortness of breath during arrhythmia episodes
searchTerms: shortness of breath with irregular heartbeat
difficulty breathing during heart rhythm episodes

occasional.symptomName: Chest discomfort or atypical chest pain
searchTerms: chest discomfort or unusual chest pain

rare.symptomName: Cerebrovascular events secondary to arrhythmia-induced embolism
searchTerms: brain events due to arrhythmia embolism

rare.symptomName: Peripheral edema due to heart failure progression
searchTerms: swelling in legs from heart failure
peripheral edema due to weak heart

imaging: Echocardiogram to assess structural heart disease
genetic: Absence of pathogenic variants in arrhythmia-related genes
other: History of precipitating factors such as ischemia, drug toxicity, or metabolic disturbances

distinguishingFeatures: Evidence of coronary artery disease on imaging
Regional wall motion abnormalities on echocardiogram

redFlags: Sudden onset syncope with no prodrome
Family history of sudden cardiac death
references: Priori SG, et al. 2015 ESC Guidelines for the management of patients with ventricular arrhythmias and the prevention of sudden cardiac death. Eur Heart J. 2015.
Zipes DP, et al. ACC/AHA/ESC 2006 Guidelines for Management of Patients With Ventricular Arrhythmias and the Prevention of Sudden Cardiac Death. Circulation. 2006.
